{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication
print(f'After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} patients')
print(f'Patient ID distribution after dedup: {df_dedup["patient_id"].value_counts().value_counts()}')

# Check arm distribution
print(f'Arm distribution: {df_dedup["arm"].value_counts()}')

# Check severity distribution by arm
print(f'Severity by arm:
{df_dedup.groupby("arm")["severity"].value_counts()}')"}
